seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. The same seed is used for every clip of a multi-clip generation.

resolution.description: Output resolution tier. Orientation follows the source video (720p is 1280x720 or 720x1280; 480p is 832x480 or 480x832).

num_inference_steps.description: Number of diffusion sampling steps per clip. Higher improves quality but is slower.

video_url.description: URL of the source video whose motion and framing drive the generation.

num_frames.description: Maximum number of output frames. Capped at the source video's frame count.

keyframes.description: Optional restyled keyframes pinned at specific output frame indices to anchor identity over long videos.

frame_index.description: 0-based output frame index for this keyframe. Must be >= 1 (frame 0 is the restyled first frame from `image_url`) and less than the output frame count.

image_url.description: URL of a restyled keyframe image. It is pinned verbatim at `frame_index` to anchor identity over long videos. Its aspect ratio must match the output aspect ratio within 0.1.

segmentation_prompt.description: Text prompt for SAM-3 subject segmentation. The segmented subject's pixels condition the generation; the rest of the frame is regenerated freely.

image_url.description: URL of the restyled first frame. The video is regenerated in this frame's identity/style.

enable_safety_checker.description: Enable safety checking of inputs and outputs.

vace_scale.description: VACE conditioning scale. Controls how strongly the source video's structure constrains the generation.

guidance_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Controls prompt adherence versus creativity.

prompt.description: The prompt describing the restyled video to generate.
examples: An astronaut walking through an autumn forest
